title: v68 ordered-work precondition gate + FAST-MVP counter-authority falsification on the post-repair (rejection/incumbent-leg) product bytes
why_this_cycle: Direction v68 ordered work item (2) is CONDITIONAL: execute the post-repair re-measure ONLY IF Core Product (a) lands the P0 rejection/incumbent leg AND (b) regenerates the full flagship offline/server slice family; otherwise record NOT_YET_DISCRIMINATING and stop, without a synthetic stand-in and without re-running the standing falsification. Since the last accepted evaluation cycle the accepted product head moved 8b5b08dd -> 8e58724b, so BOTH halves of that precondition must now be adjudicated from committed bytes rather than from prose. Item (3) separately permits a NEW pre-registered falsification on NEW bytes with its own freeze-first record. This instrument is that freeze-first record plus the executable precondition adjudicator, so the next cycle does not have to re-derive either question by hand.
fast_mvp_directive: FAST MVP MODE: smallest executable retrieval/counter-authority benchmark that can falsify the product, reusing existing multilingual/provenance assets; no obsolete universal-174k benchmark is rerun.
claim_ceiling: Two narrowly scoped things only: (1) a SET-RELATION adjudication of the v68 item-(2) precondition against committed product bytes (leg markers with file:line, post-repair bundle inventory, frozen-probe-family coverage, Product's own family claim); (2) a NEW pre-registered FAST-MVP counter-authority falsification on the NEW post-repair bundle bytes, reusing the frozen D1-D4 predicates and the accepted relation engine BY HASH-VERIFIED IMPORT. It (a) does NOT discharge ordered item (2): the frozen 15-member probe family is the named family and this run reports its coverage, it does not silently substitute a different family; (b) does NOT re-run, replace, weaken or move the benchmark of record PRODUCT_FALSIFIED on packet-of-record 39319405429, which is NOT read for scoring here; (c) does NOT re-run d2_path_scope_probe as the ordered item-(2) re-measure; (d) edits NO frozen bar, rubric, threshold, predicate, tokeniser, stoplist or verdict contract; (e) issues NO serve verdict, lifts NO DO-NOT-SERVE order, admits NO packet; (f) makes NO claim that the map helps a jurist; (g) runs NO universal-174k benchmark; (h) makes NO recall claim against a live baseline. Posture stays fail-closed: packet_admitted=false, machine_gate_ready=false, human_gate_ready=false, ready_for_owner_session=false, owner_decision_required=false.

hypothesis.H1_precondition_leg_landed: At mount head, product/query/counter_evidence_span.py contains the v68 rejection/incumbent leg (symbols _content_rejection_sweep and n_incumbent_downgraded, plus a 'REJECTION/INCUMBENT' comment) at recorded file:line, AND every population bundle except the not-enriched control carries provenance.counter_evidence_span.content_filter. If false, item (2) precondition (a) is unmet and the run reports PRECONDITION_LEG_NOT_LANDED.
hypothesis.H2_precondition_full_family_regenerated: Every member of the FROZEN 15-bundle probe family (the flagship offline/server slice family the accepted counter_evidence_quality_benchmark baselines on: 11 offline rent-default + 4 server served) has a DISTINCT post-repair counterpart of the same (slice_kind, query) role, matched member-for-member with multiplicity (each frozen member matches at most one post-repair bundle). Path identity is structurally impossible while the baseline family is preserved byte-for-byte, so it is reported as one relation among three (path-identity sets, role table, member-for-member matching) and is never the sole basis of the verdict (factory-wide requirement 16: sets, never cardinalities). If FALSE, ordered item (2)'s full protocol (frozen protocol on the named family AND packet-of-record 39319405429 side by side AND d2_path_scope_probe) is NOT executed and stays NOT_YET_DISCRIMINATING.
hypothesis.H3_falsification_target_on_post_repair_b: On the post-repair population, every verified scored counter row carries at least one frozen D1-D4 content defect (i.e. the rejection/incumbent leg did NOT remove defective verified evidence). If TRUE -> CAPABILITY_FALSIFIED_CONTENT_DEFECTIVE (exit 1). If FALSE and at least one enriched bundle carries a defect-free verified scored row -> SOUND_COUNTER_ROW_PRESENT (exit 0).
hypothesis.H4_controls_all_hold: Controls C1-C4, byte-identical to the accepted FAST-MVP falsifier's battery, all hold.
hypothesis.H5_pins_identical_before_and_after: Every frozen-input and population sha256 verified before AND after execution; any drift makes the run NOT_MEASURED_VACUOUS (exit 2).

pre_freeze_disclosure_VERBATIM: Scoping inspection BEFORE this freeze (required disclosure): from the product mount I read (i) directory listings of offline_slice/server_slice, (ii) provenance.counter_evidence_span blocks of candidate bundles (content_filter presence, n_downgraded, n_incumbent_downgraded, abstained_ids, abstention_reasons, product-authored downgrade records including the product's own 'defects' labels), (iii) per-bundle counts of rows with counter_evidence_verified=true and the counter_status distribution, (iv) sha256 of every bundle pinned above, (v) file:line of the rejection/incumbent leg markers. NOT executed before the freeze: CQ.classify_verified_row on any post-repair row, MF.counter_authority_surface on any post-repair bundle, and therefore no D1-D4 histogram, no sound-row classification and no verdict of this run. The product-authored 'defects' labels seen in provenance are Product's own output, not this run's measurement, and are never used as the measurement. The frozen D1-D4 classification is executed only after the freeze-first commit.
